subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Induction of Labour: Bishop, Ripening, Oxytocin and VBAC

steps.tx: Artificial initiation of labour before spontaneous onset is **induction of labour**. Indications from post term to pre-eclampsia share one test: vaginal birth must be safer than continuing pregnancy. One in five labours in many systems is induced. Post dates beyond 41 weeks is the commonest indication in most maternity units.
steps.say: Induction of labour starts labour artificially when vaginal birth beats continuing pregnancy.

steps.tx: Cervical favourability deciding method and success is scored by the **Bishop score** at induction. Unfavourable scores need ripening first; favourable cervices proceed to amniotomy and oxytocin. Reassessment after ripening is mandatory. Scores run to 13, and six or more is usually counted favourable for amniotomy and oxytocin.
steps.say: Bishop score decides ripening need at induction, with reassessment mandatory after.

steps.tx: Softening and effacing the cervix before contractions is **cervical ripening**. Prostaglandins, balloon catheters and osmotic dilators all achieve it by different mechanisms. Balloon methods suit scarred uteri where prostaglandins are risky. A Foley balloon left for 12 to 24 hours ripens by pressure and local prostaglandin release.
steps.say: Cervical ripening softens the cervix, with balloons suiting scarred uteri.

steps.tx: The prostaglandin preparation in this picture does two jobs at once. **Dinoprostone** ripens the cervix by remodelling its collagen and also primes the uterus to contract, which is why it begins so many inductions. Given as gel or a controlled release pessary, it can be removed or allowed to finish depending on formulation. Hyperstimulation is its recognised hazard, so fetal monitoring follows administration rather than preceding it as a formality.
steps.say: Dinoprostone ripens the cervix and primes contractions at induction. Fetal monitoring follows it because hyperstimulation is the recognised hazard.

steps.tx: The vaginal prostaglandin E2 preparation standard for ripening is **dinoprostone**. Gel or controlled release pessary forms allow removal if hyperstimulation strikes the pessary form. Monitoring follows administration per protocol. The pessary releases 10 milligrams over 24 hours and can be pulled out like a tampon if contractions overdo it.
steps.say: Dinoprostone ripens the cervix as gel or removable controlled release pessary.

steps.tx: Low dose oral or vaginal prostaglandin E1 used widely for induction and fetal death is **misoprostol**. It is cheap, stable at room temperature and powerful in small divided doses. Scarred uteri restrict its use near term. Twenty five micrograms vaginally every four to six hours is a common low dose regimen near term.
steps.say: Misoprostol induces labour cheaply and stably, restricted in scarred uteri.

steps.tx: A balloon catheter inflated in the cervix ripening by pressure and local prostaglandins is the **Foley catheter** method. Thirty to eighty millilitres for twelve to twenty four hours effaces most cervices. It is the method of choice after caesarean in many units.
steps.say: Foley catheter ripening suits post caesarean induction by mechanical pressure.

steps.tx: Titrated intravenous hormone driving contractions after membrane rupture is **oxytocin** induction. Dose rises by protocol against contraction frequency and fetal response. It needs continuous monitoring and a dedicated line. Contractions of three to four in ten minutes are the aim, and the dose doubles no faster than every 30 minutes.
steps.say: Oxytocin induction titrates against contractions and fetal response with continuous monitoring.

steps.tx: Artificial rupture of membranes releasing local prostaglandins and committing to delivery is **amniotomy**. It is avoided with a high head because of cord prolapse. Once done, the clock toward delivery and infection awareness starts. Listening to the fetal heart immediately before and after rupture is the safety ritual that catches cord prolapse early.
steps.say: Amniotomy commits to delivery and is avoided with a high head for cord risk.

steps.tx: More than five contractions in ten minutes, with or without fetal changes, defines **tachysystole** and hyperstimulation when the heart suffers. Stopping oxytocin and tocolysis reverse it. Induction protocols exist largely to prevent this state, and augmentation of spontaneous labour follows the same rules at lower intensity, while scarred uterus induction in VBAC avoids misoprostol and favours balloon plus careful oxytocin.
steps.say: Tachysystole overstimulates the uterus and stopping oxytocin reverses it.
